static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents，家中有三只狗
static_traits.social_status: 有父母和朋友作为Average支持，但尚not yet与他们讨论该具体问题
static_traits.medical_history: without类似问题经历；without既往心理咨询或治疗史；without显著躯体疾病

basic_info.main_problem: 我一直觉得自己not是一个好的宠物主人，尽管父亲因为我照顾狗狗Maddie而给了我额外的零用钱。自上周收到额外零用钱后开始出现这种感受，并在收到赞扬时反复出现；我一直把正向反馈过滤掉，只关注负面方面。
basic_info.core_demands: 因对自己作为宠物主人的能力感到困惑与not确定而寻求澄清与支持。

special_situations.event: Father gave me an extra 10 dollars of allowance because I took care of the dog Maddie
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我仍有疏漏或not完美，就not配得到奖励或赞美
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: deny或贬低正向反馈，反复挑错以证明自己not值得
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not配得到这笔钱；我并have not做得好

special_situations.event: 父亲称赞我照顾Maddie做得很好
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有做到完美才算做好；只要有任何差错就说明我not是好宠物主人
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只关注失误与not完美，忽略整体表现
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我其实做得并not好，我有很多错误

special_situations.event: 在被他人（尤其父亲）赞扬照顾Maddie时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: do not人给的赞美not可靠，他们只是have not看到我的not足
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避谈论自己的正面表现，not与他人分享，独自反刍负面细节
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们只是忽略了我做错的地方，所以赞美have not意义

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被肯定与认可为称职的宠物主人
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看穿自己的not足、觉得not配得到赞美，进而被negate
defense_goal: 通过贬低正向反馈与挑错来维持自我一致并降低被negate的风险
保持距离于赞美以减轻“not配”的Anxiety感

object_relations.self_representation: not称职、容易犯错、需要证明价值的人
object_relations.object_representation: 过于宽容的赞许者（父亲），其赞美可能忽视我的not足

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others give positive evaluations, encourage her to acknowledge positive feedback, or suggest cognitive restructuring
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方在忽视自己的缺点或强求自己接受not真实的评价，因此需要用“挑错”来保护自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: In a gentle, empathic tone: first affirm their caution and responsibility, then invite them to concretize evidence (listing positive and negative facts at the same time); avoid confrontational correction, use exploratory questioning, helping them contact emotions and facts simultaneously.

manifestations: 质疑自己作为宠物主人的价值与意义
在收到赞扬时negate其意义，将正向反馈视为not可靠
outcomes: 难以体验到成就感与被认可的满足

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 以完美标准衡量自己：只有做到毫without差错才算“好”
Uses 'should/must' implicit rules to judge whether oneself deserves praise

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'. Language manifestations include: 'Speaking of which... haha, just kidding', 'In theory...', and so on。
manifestations: 在被赞扬时立刻转而强调错误与not足，回避直接接触正向反馈
not与亲友讨论该具体问题，回避他人正向反应的影响

问题聚焦且范围有限（not yet影响学业、人际与日常）

Willing to try recording and noticing negative automatic thoughts, proactively seeks counseling support

在收到赞美时让负性思维占据，产生强烈Self-doubt与低落
因尴尬而回避与他人讨论该具体问题，巩固内在Self-denial

target_behavior.behavior: 在收到赞扬或奖励时，negate正向反馈并陷入Self-doubt与低落
antecedent: Father gives extra allowance or verbal praise for how she cares for Maddie
他人对其养宠行为的正面评价
target_behavior.core_reason: 受“只要not完美就not配被赞”的Introjection规则影响，加之认知歪曲（negate正面与心理过滤）驱动，将局部失误视为整体not称职
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate或“被看穿not足”的潜在风险，维持自我概念的一致性，短暂降低“not配感”的Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Self-doubt与低落加重，难以获得肯定与成就感；目前not yet明显影响学业、人际与日常生活
